title: Apparel Designer I, Design Exploration
location: Baltimore, MD · hybrid (4 days in office)
note: Entry apparel design role (bachelor's plus about 2 years typical); must live within commuting distance, no relocation or visa sponsorship.

facts.summary: Junior apparel designer supporting the Design Exploration team under the design director.
facts.duties: Sketching, tech packs and bills of materials, seasonal line development and fittings, color and merchandising pages, presentation files.
facts.requirements: Bachelor's with typically 2 years experience; sketching; Illustrator and Photoshop; understanding of garment construction and textiles.
